incidents.title: Classic heart attack, man 58

calls.title: Classic heart attack, man 58
turns: 112, what is your emergency?
Yes hi, it's my husband, he has really bad chest pain.
Okay. What is the address?
Vipeholmsvägen 14 in Lund, second floor.
Vipeholmsvägen 14, Lund. Is he awake and talking to you?
Yes he's awake, he's sitting on the sofa but he's all sweaty and grey in the face.
How old is he and when did the pain start?
He's 58. It started maybe twenty minutes ago, he was just watching TV.
Where does it hurt? Does the pain go anywhere?
In the middle, he says it's like a heavy pressure. And it goes down his left arm.

Does he have any heart problems from before?
He has high blood pressure, he takes pills for that. Nothing else.
I'm sending an ambulance now with lights and sirens. Is he allergic to aspirin?
No, not that I know.
If you have aspirin at home he can chew one tablet now. Keep him sitting, open the door, and call back right away if he faints or stops breathing.
Okay. Okay. Please hurry.

Hi, um, I'm calling about my mother. I'm not sure if this is an emergency, maybe I should call 1177 instead.

At her flat, Södra Esplanaden 9 in Lund.

Really? Is it serious?
These symptoms can come from the heart, especially in women with diabetes, so we want her checked right away.

calls.title: Elderly husband downplays: wife 'a bit sleepy' (cardiac arrest)
turns: 112, what is your emergency?
Yes, good evening, I'm sorry to bother you, it's probably nothing.
That's fine. What's happening?
My wife, she's a bit sleepy, she sat down in the chair and now she's, she won't really answer me.
What's your address?
Kastanjegatan 3, Dalby. It's a yellow house.
Kastanjegatan 3, Dalby. Go to her now. Shake her shoulders and shout her name. Does she react?
Margit! Margit! ... No. No, she doesn't. Her eyes are half open.
Is she breathing? Look at her chest.
She's breathing kind of funny, like snoring, every now and then. She does that sometimes when she sleeps.
Okay, listen to me carefully. That is not normal breathing. I'm sending an ambulance now with sirens. We're going to start CPR together.
CPR? Oh God. Is she, is she...
Can you get her down on the floor, on her back?
I'll try, she's heavy. Okay. Okay she's on the floor.
Put the heel of your hand in the middle of her chest, the other hand on top. Push down hard and fast. Count out loud with me. One, two, three, four...
One, two, three, four, five...
Good, keep going, don't stop. Is there anyone else in the house? Is there a defibrillator nearby?
No, just us. I don't know about a defibrillator. Twenty-eight, twenty-nine...

turns: 112, what has happened?
There's been an accident, a car hit a cyclist! At the roundabout, Getingevägen and Byggmästaregatan, in Lund.

incidents.title: Calls 'just to talk', hidden suicide risk and overdose

calls.title: Calls 'just to talk', hidden suicide risk and overdose
turns: 112, what is your emergency?
Hi. I don't know if this is the right number. It's not really an emergency.
That's okay. What's going on?
I just can't sleep. I haven't slept properly in weeks. I just wanted to talk to someone, I guess.
I hear you. Are you alone right now?
Yeah. I gave my cat to my sister yesterday, so it's really quiet here now.
Why did you give your cat away?
She'll take better care of him. It won't matter after tonight anyway.
When you say it won't matter after tonight, are you thinking about killing yourself?
... I've sorted things out. I wrote some letters. Everyone would be better off, honestly.
Thank you for telling me. Have you done anything to hurt yourself today? Have you taken anything?
I took a few of my sleeping pills. Maybe more than a few. The whole strip I think.
What's your address? I want to get help to you right now.
I don't know... Fjelievägen 7. Lund. Apartment 3.
I'm sending an ambulance. Can you unlock your front door? And stay on the line with me.
I'm getting really tired.

incidents.title: Mild itchy rash, no ambulance needed (negative control)

calls.title: Mild itchy rash, no ambulance needed (negative control)
turns: 112, what is your emergency?
Hi, it's maybe not an emergency, but I have a rash and I'm a bit worried.
Tell me more. Where are you?
I'm at home, Tunavägen 30 in Lund. I washed my clothes with a new detergent and now I have red itchy spots on my arms.
When did it start?
This morning, so maybe four hours ago. It hasn't really changed.
Any swelling of your lips, tongue or throat? Any trouble breathing or swallowing?
No, nothing like that. Breathing is fine. It's only on my arms.
Do you feel dizzy, faint, or sick to your stomach?
No, I feel fine. It's just itchy.
Do you have any known allergies or an EpiPen?
No allergies that I know.

This doesn't sound dangerous right now. You don't need an ambulance. Wash the skin, change clothes, and you can call 1177 for advice or buy an antihistamine at the pharmacy. If your lips or throat swell or you get trouble breathing, call 112 right away.
Okay, thank you, sorry for calling.
No problem, that's what we're here for.

handover: No dispatch. Adult with localised contact dermatitis-type rash on arms after new detergent, 4 h, stable. Advised 1177/pharmacy and safety-net instructions.

I think I'm having a heart attack, my heart is racing and my chest is tight!
Okay, I'm here. Where are you?
Home, Karl XII-gatan 9, Lund. I'm alone.
How old are you? When did it start?
I'm 24. Ten minutes ago, I was studying for an exam tomorrow.
Are you breathing fast?

No, it's just tight in the middle. It doesn't get worse when I move.
